tasks.title: Endgame signal only
tasks.finish: src/endgame.py emits a signal when a fixture price is between 0.98 and 0.99 and the market ends within 48 hours. It never emits a fill or an order. pytest passes with no network and no credentials. config/risk.toml is unchanged.

tasks.title: Offline Brier proposal
tasks.finish: src/quant.py scores a local fixture with Brier mean((p-y)^2) and emits at most one proposal. It does not edit config/risk.toml or any size cap. pytest passes offline. No network and no credentials.
